verdict: AUTHOR SURVEY OUTLINE ONLY; NOT A COMPLETE ALTERNATE FLYPING PROOF PLAN

exact_scope.p3: Author expressly restricts the story to knots and says extension to alternating links is left for another time. No all-links proof can be imported from this survey.
exact_scope.p4: T3 stated: any two reduced alternating diagrams of a given knot type are related by a sequence of flypes. No detailed technical hypothesis inventory accompanies a numbered flyping theorem.

actual_architecture.content: Jones/Kauffman bracket machinery controls crossing number; T1 and writhe context are summarized.
actual_architecture.status: Substantial expository algebra outline, not a new proof of the geometric flyping step. This does not bypass the missing incidence/alignment analysis.

actual_architecture.content: Two key geometric facts are stated: checkerboard spanning surfaces for reduced alternating diagrams are incompressible and contain no meridional simple closed curve.
actual_architecture.status: Statements, not proofs, in the flyping discussion. Background bibliography onp11 points to Menasco1984,1985 and Menasco–Thistlethwaite1992. No precise reduction of the flyping proof to numbered lemmas is supplied.

actual_architecture.content: Place the two pairs of colored surfaces in relative position and use nesting arguments to obtain intersection arcs away from each pair’s half-twisted-band intersections.
actual_architecture.status: Asserted strategy only. No full normalization construction, hypotheses, invariants, exceptional cases or endpoint/peripheral bookkeeping is provided.

actual_architecture.content: Try to line up crossings of the two diagrams. Extensive arc-intersection analysis yields a flype if the diagrams are not isotopic.
actual_architecture.status: This is exactly the unprovided central classification: no definition of the alignment complexity, case list, local-to-global flype recognition proof, or numbered intermediate theorem appears.

actual_architecture.content: After sufficiently many flypes more crossings line up; when all line up the diagrams are isotopic.
actual_architecture.status: No explicit monotone complexity, preservation-of-already-aligned-data proof, termination bound or final diagram-identification construction is supplied. These are actual missing proof operations, not details justified by the phrase sufficiently many.
